verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents shipping from GitHub or the CLI with `fly launch`, which creates, configures and deploys the app. It also generates a Dockerfile for popular frameworks when none exists, so no manual build configuration is needed. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the GitHub repo-connection flow (it gets a single line), coverage of frameworks outside the generator list, and independent hands-on corroboration of the repo-connect path.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my app by simply connecting my repo without manual build configuration

citations.quote: Ship from GitHub or our CLI with `fly launch`.
No Dockerfile? No problem: we'll generate one for most popular frameworks, including Rails, Phoenix, Django, Node, Laravel, Go, Rust, .NET and more.
Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.
